nodes.name: CRM Events Webhook
nodes.notes: Raw Body is on: Verify CRM Event checks the HMAC over the exact request bytes, never over the parsed JSON.

parameters.query:
-- Apply one verified CRM chat.take / chat.release event (crm-inbound-events).
-- p1 event_id, p2 sha256 hex of the raw request body, p3 type, p4
-- crm_opportunity_id, p5 crm_seller_id, p6 data.ownership_version.
--
-- The signature, size and envelope were already verified by Verify CRM Event.
-- Everything else happens in one transaction inside
-- crm_inbound_apply_chat_event() (migration 040): the idempotency inbox (same
-- id and bytes replay the stored response; same id, other bytes answer 409
-- event_conflict), opportunity and seller resolution (422), the stale-version
-- check, the holder conflict (409) and the take / release itself, which copies
-- the ClickUp acquire and release semantics without writing ClickUp columns.
-- It is a function so the response can carry the ownership_version that the
-- lead_chat_ownerships trigger wrote in the same transaction.
SELECT http_status, response, replayed
FROM crm_inbound_apply_chat_event(
  NULLIF($1::text, ''),
  NULLIF($2::text, ''),
  NULLIF($3::text, ''),
  NULLIF($4::text, '')::uuid,
  NULLIF($5::text, '')::uuid,
  NULLIF($6::text, '')::bigint
);

nodes.name: Apply CRM Chat Event
nodes.notes: A database failure continues to Build CRM Event Response, which answers 503 so the CRM retries the same bytes.

parameters.query:
-- Claim one verified CRM message.send event before Evolution is called
-- (crm-inbound-events). p1 event_id, p2 sha256 hex of the raw request body,
-- p3 crm_opportunity_id, p4 crm_seller_id, p5 client_message_id, p6
-- data.ownership_version, p7 the trimmed text.
--
-- The signature, size, envelope and data were already verified by Verify CRM
-- Event. crm_inbound_claim_message_send() (migration 041) decides in one
-- transaction: idempotency (stored answers, 409 event_conflict, 503 while an
-- earlier attempt is in flight or ambiguous), opportunity and seller (422),
-- ownership (implicit chat.take when the bot holds the chat, 409
-- ownership_conflict when another seller does) and the claim of the send
-- intent. send = TRUE carries what Send CRM Message needs; otherwise
-- http_status and response are the final answer.
SELECT http_status, response, replayed, send, outbound_id, attempt, phone_number, instance_name, text_body
FROM crm_inbound_claim_message_send(
  NULLIF($1::text, ''),
  NULLIF($2::text, ''),
  NULLIF($3::text, '')::uuid,
  NULLIF($4::text, '')::uuid,
  NULLIF($5::text, '')::uuid,
  NULLIF($6::text, '')::bigint,
  NULLIF($7::text, '')
);

nodes.name: Claim CRM Message Send
nodes.notes: Persists and claims the send intent before Evolution is called. A database failure continues to Build CRM Event Response, which answers 503; nothing was sent.

nodes.name: Send CRM Message
nodes.notes: One POST to Evolution, never retried here: a resend after an ambiguous result could reach the customer twice.

parameters.query:
-- Record the Evolution outcome of one claimed CRM message.send attempt
-- (crm-inbound-events). p1 outbound_id, p2 attempt, p3 outcome (sent | failed
-- | unknown), p4 Evolution message id, p5 Evolution HTTP status, p6 bounded
-- error text, p7 CRM_EVENTS_ID_PREFIX.
--
-- crm_inbound_complete_message_send() (migration 041): 'sent' stores the
-- outgoing seller message (or adopts the row its fromMe echo already stored)
-- and answers 200 {event_id, result: "sent", message_id, ownership_version};
-- 'failed' and 'unknown' answer 503. Only the attempt still 'sending' moves.
SELECT http_status, response
FROM crm_inbound_complete_message_send(
  NULLIF($1::text, '')::bigint,
  NULLIF($2::text, '')::integer,
  NULLIF($3::text, ''),
  NULLIF($4::text, ''),
  NULLIF($5::text, '')::integer,
  NULLIF($6::text, ''),
  NULLIF($7::text, '')
);

nodes.name: Complete CRM Message Send
nodes.notes: A database failure here leaves the intent in 'sending' and answers 503; it is never resent automatically (operator note in docs/crm-integration/README.md).
